sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:96110
Court No. - 43

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 17935 of 2025
Applicant :- Shivdhani Kol

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Neeraj Kumar Srivastava,Pankaj Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble J.J. Munir,J.
This is the first bail application on behalf of the applicant Shivdhani Kol in connection with Case
Crime No. 0089 of 2025 under Section 3(1) of U.P. Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities
(Prevention) Act, 1986, Police Station Ghorawal, District Sonbhadra.

Heard Ms. Jagriti Shukla, learned Counsel holding brief of Mr. Neeraj Kumar Srivastava, learned
Counsel for the applicant and Mr. K. K. Nishad, learned Additional Government Advocate appearing
for the State.

The submission of learned Counsel for the applicant is that the applicant has been challaned in the present case on the basis of a solitary base case, being Case Crime No. 233 of 2022, under Section 60(2)/72 C Excise Act and Section 272, 273, 34, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Ghorawal,
District Sonbhadra wherein the applicant has been charge-sheeted but admitted to bail.
It is next submitted that the applicant is neither the leader nor a member of the gang and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.

It is also argued that though the Superintendent of Police and the District Magistrate have approved the gang chart on the same day but there is nothing to show that Shivdhani Kol vs State Of U.P. on 9 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107556195/
1 they have sat together in a meeting and applied their mind together before the District Magistrate has granted approval, as required under Rule 5(3) of U.P. Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Rules, 2021.

entities.text: Shivdhani Kol vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: U.P. Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Rules, 2021
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 12.05.2025.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the plea for bail.

Considering the totality of circumstances in particular the fact that the applicant is involved in a solitary base case wherein he is on bail pending trial, the fact that prima facie the applicant does not appear to be a member or the leader of a gang, the fact that there is prima facie a violation of Rule 5(3) of U.P. Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Rules, 2021, the fact that the applicant is in jail since 12.05.2025, we find it to be a fit case for bail.

entities.text: U.P. Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Rules, 2021
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The bail application, accordingly, stands allowed.

Let the applicant Shivdhani Kol in connection with Case Crime No. 0089 of 2025 under Section 3(1)
of U.P. Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986, Police Station Ghorawal, District Sonbhadra be enlarged on bail on executing his personal bond and furnishing two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sonbhadra with the following conditions:
i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence.
ii) The applicant shall not threaten or harass the prosecution witnesses.

entities.text: U.P. Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: iii) The applicant shall appear on the date fixed by the trial court.
iv) The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which the applicant is accused, or suspected of the commission.

v) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade such person from disclosing facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of default of any of the conditions enumerated above, the complainant would be free to move an application for cancellation of bail before this Court.

It is clarified that anything said in this order is limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression of opinion on the merits of the case.
It is further clarified that the trial Court shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led, unaffected by anything said in this order.
